div.head: Norðleoda 9
div.ab: And gif ceorlisc man geþeo, þæt he hæbbe V hida landes to cynges utware, ⁊ hine man ofslea, forgilde man hine mid twam þusend þrimsa.
⁊ gif ceorlisc man geþeo, þæt he hæbbe V hida landes to cynges utware, ⁊ man hine ofslea, forgylde man hine mid II þusend þrymsa.
Gif ceorl sie gewelegod to ðam, þæt age V hyda landes, ⁊ mon hine ofslea, gyld hine mon mid II m. ðrimsa.
Et si ceorlman promoueatur, ut habeat V hidas terre ad regis utware et occidatur, reddatur duobus milibus þrimsa.
And gif ceorlisc man geþeo, þæt he hæbbe V hida landes to cynges utware and man hine ofslea, forgylde man hine mid II þusend þrymsa.

Und wenn ein gemeinfreier Mann emporkommt (Gemeinfreier zu dém [Grade] reich wird Ld), dass er 5 Hiden Landes [dienstpflichtig] zum königlichen Fernheer besitzt, und erschlagen wird, werde er mit 2000 Tremissen [25 Pfund] entgolten.

And if a ceorl prospers (a ceorl becomes rich to that [degree], Ld) so that he holds 5 hides of land [liable to service] for the king's army, and is slain, let him be paid for with 2,000 thrymsas [25 pounds].
And if a ceorl prospers, that he has five hides of land on which he discharges the king's dues, and anyone kills him, he is to be paid for with 2,000 thrymsas.
And if a commoner prospers so that he possesses five hides of land for his obligations to the king and anyone kills him, compensation for him shall be two thousand thrymsas.

Diesen Satz erweitert Geþyncðo 2. 3. Wie dort 3⁴ ersetze Übs. ‘königl. Fernheer’ durch ‘Verantwortung für die staatliche Grundlast ausserhalb [des Herrschaftsgutes]’.—Vgl. Gl Thegn 9a. 13; Wergeld 9; Grundbesitz 8

This sentence is expanded in Geþyncðo 2. 3. As there in 3⁴, replace ‘king’s levy for distant service’ in the transl. by ‘responsibility for the public charge on land outside [the demesne]’. — Cf. Gl Thegn 9a. 13; Wergeld 9; Grundbesitz 8
